scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector: Assistance of Interest Subsidy
other_conditions: The applicant must be a new large industrial undertaking or an existing one undertaking expansion and/or diversification.
The undertaking must have obtained acknowledgment/registration from the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
Commercial production must commence within the scheme's operative period (5 Oct 2022 to 4 Oct 2027).
benefits_summary: Provides an interest subsidy of up to 7% on term loans for 6–10 years, amounting to up to 1–1.2% of the estimated Fixed Capital Investment per annum.
